home.ledgerSubtitle: On the left, the work as it runs by hand today; on the right, where the same work lands in the panel. The comparison is not against a rival product — it is against management without software.
home.ledgerBefore: The dues list lives in a spreadsheet; balances get posted to a WhatsApp group|Faults are reported verbally — who looked at what, and when, is anyone's guess|Expense receipts sit in a folder and get hunted down one by one at audit time|Assembly notices are handed out in person, with no proof of service|Resident phone numbers live in the manager's personal contacts
home.ledgerAfter: Accrual is automatic; residents check their balance over WhatsApp and pay by card|Requests move against an SLA; every step is timestamped and visible|Income and expenses in one book; trial balance and reports in one click|Notice, quorum and the decision book are all kept in the system|The data protection log and role separation come set up
home.panelTitle: See collection without waiting for month end
home.panelBody: Collection rate, open requests and cash flow greet you at login. Open a unit and its balance history, payment method and sent reminders are on the same screen.
home.panelPoints: Collection rate and overdue ageing, live|Open requests sorted by remaining SLA time|WhatsApp and SMS sends, with read receipts|Trial balance, income–expense and debt list in one click
home.audienceTitle: The panel is not only for the manager
home.audienceSubtitle: Residents, auditors and staff all see the same data through their own permissions — no second program, no second list, no second spreadsheet.
home.residentTitle: Residents find out without asking the manager
home.residentBody: No waiting for office hours to learn what you owe. A resident checks their balance over WhatsApp with a single word and pays by card without installing anything; the mobile app is there for whoever wants it.
home.residentPoints: Balance lookup over WhatsApp and payment with 3-D Secure|Receipts and bank slips as PDFs, instantly|Fault reports with photos, and a status you can follow|Announcements go out through a data protection filter
home.residentImageAlt: Two phone screens from the resident app: cash balance, pending tasks and action cards
home.siteTitle: One panel, from a single building to a multi-block estate
home.siteBody: Blocks, units, parking, common areas and staff live in one hierarchy. Manage more than one property and you get a combined view; auditors get read-only access.
home.sitePoints: Block–unit hierarchy and accrual based on land share|Common area booking, meter reading and cost sharing|Staff, timesheets and supplier contracts|Read-only access for auditors, with a complete audit trail
home.siteImageAlt: Three-dimensional building blocks representing the estate and its blocks

migration.metaDescription: Import your data from Apsiyon, Biyos, Dijiyon, Yönetimcell or Excel. We charge nothing until your current contract ends.
migration.title: Switching is easier than you think
migration.subtitle: The average switch takes one hour. If your current software contract is still running, we charge nothing until it ends (up to 12 months) — you never pay twice.
migration.step1Body: Download the unit list, resident details and current balances from your existing software as Excel.
migration.step2Body: Drop the file into the import wizard. Columns are detected automatically; you map any that aren't.
migration.step3Body: How many units, how many residents, how much balance will be imported — you see the report before saving.
migration.step4Body: After the import, compare against the old system using the balance reconciliation report.
migration.ownershipBody: You can export all of your data as Excel and JSON at any time. Even if you decide to leave us, the export is free — we don't lock you in.
